WIFF.definition: recognize/sniff without executing or issuing subject identity

TASTE.definition: validate and qualify; establish subject genesis identity on PASS

SPIT.definition: reject admission; no subject persistence by default

SWALLOW.definition: admit to final build/compute, placement and STREAM

STREAM.definition: emit admitted file bytes to host-owned placement

B32KID.definition: profile-versioned object label derived from a normative B32K handle

handle.definition: BLAKE3 domain-separated digest binding canonical payload to version/lane context

O-1 receipt.definition: ledger inclusion proof defined by B32K Appendix C
